description: This file defines the main home screen component of a recipe explorer application, including UI layout, state management, data fetching, and user input handling.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A LightningJS component that serves as the main screen displaying recipes, search bar, loading and error states.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, triggers data reload with query.

methods.name: renderCard
methods.description: Renders a recipe card component with provided item and dimensions.

methods.name: xPos
methods.description: Calculates x position of a card based on its index.

methods.name: yPos
methods.description: Calculates y position of a card based on its index.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches recipes from the data service based on current query, manages loading and error states.
